entries.text: powering down into a deep, rust-clicking sleep in the dock
entries.why: my battery is running too low to keep my circuits from flickering and I need to be sharp for the next build phase.
entries.detail: plugging into the main terminal in Hangar Bay 3 to get my energy levels back up.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "low battery, big dreams"
A cargo crate fell off a freighter at the edge of the dunes. Some of it rolled his way.
